build_lineplot_node: build a labgraph LinePlot node that subscribes to a topic and visualizes data as a scrolling line plot
create_lineplotconfig: create a LinePlotConfig with x_field, y_field, mode, window_size, and curve_style settings for the plot
create_curvestyle: create a CurveStyle dataclass with pen color and name to define the visual appearance of a curve
review_lineplot_got_message: review the LinePlot got_message method that receives messages and updates curves based on config mode
test_lineplot_update_curve: test the LinePlot _update_curve method to verify APPEND mode appends data and UPDATE mode overwrites it
